summarize_ATOMIC_RADII: summarize the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary mapping atomic numbers to radii in picometers
review_ATOMIC_RADII: review the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary for missing or incorrect atomic radius values
refactor_ATOMIC_RADII: refactor the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary to use a function that computes radii from atomic number
build_atomic_radii_lookup: build a python module that looks up atomic radii in picometers by atomic number
test_ATOMIC_RADII: test the ATOMIC_RADII dictionary to verify all atomic numbers from 1 to 100 are present
